ascension: Defeat the Bell-Sworn Prelate at the Sundered Bell, in the Bell Sanctum (5 soul shards), and the Altar will open to you.
It is far ahead of you yet, and entirely optional.

out.farewell: The door is always open.

greet: Mind the graves, they are tended. I am the Sexton; this Acre is mine and, I suppose, yours now.
Nothing here bites. Trees, seams, pools and graves: pick whichever takes your fancy.
advice: 2 of your laborers have a good haul waiting. Press H to collect it and set them back to work.

gather: Higher tiers need higher skill. Press P to see what you unlock next, and Start AFK to keep a node worked while you do other things.
Your laborers have work waiting: press H.
grinder: The Bone Grinder, beside the kiln, turns spare gear into ingots and planks, and trains Salvaging. Worn and padlocked pieces are never touched.
The Ossuary Vault (V), here or in the Chapterhouse, keeps 120 slots shared by every character on your account.
contracts: Three orders a day (O), easy to hard, drawn from what your skills can make. Deliver from your bag for gold, and sometimes an item. Now and then I want gems, fragments or seals; I pay double for those.
3 of today’s 3 are still open.

out.farewell: Come back with dirt on your boots.

greet: Hush, mind the vials. This is my Wing now: the Great Cauldron, the Alembic, and the Shelf where every reagent you find gets its place.
Four Grave Dust and a little patience make a first tonic. Ask, and I will tell you what to brew.
advice: You carry 6 Grave Dust. At the Great Cauldron here, four of them brew a Grave-Dust Tonic: more essence regeneration for a minute.
The first brew anyone can make from what the dead drop.

brewing: The Great Cauldron or the Alembic here in the Wing. Each recipe wants reagents and a level in Alchemy, which brewing itself trains.
You have the dust for a first tonic (6).
reagents: Grave Dust: the Hollow Graves and the Catacomb Warren. Wraith Ectoplasm: spirits. Plague Bile: the Cloister. Cinder Ash: the Pyre.
Every area boss leaves an ichor. Herbs such as rot-cap and ash-bloom grow in the Acre from foraged seeds (U).
Spirits drop Wraith Ectoplasm. Each deeper hall adds a reagent of its own; I will tell you as you open them.
belt: You have two brew slots: an Elixir for combat (Z) and a Tonic for everything else (X). A new elixir replaces the old one.
Right-click a brew in the Reliquary (I) to put it on your belt. Drinking the same brew again extends it, up to twice its length.

out.farewell: Come back alive, I have questions.
